clauses.heading: Information we collect and its sources
clauses.body: We collect identifiers (name, email, postal address, account ID and IP address) directly from you and through device interaction; customer records information (name and postal address) directly from you; internet or other electronic network activity (event views and searches) through device interaction; geolocation information (declared city and coarse IP-derived city) directly from you and through device interaction; inferences (music interests inferred from saved event categories) from first-party interactions; and sensitive personal information (account login combined with access credentials) directly from you.

clauses.heading: How we use information
clauses.body: We use identifiers to create and service accounts, deliver selected local event recommendations and protect security; customer records information to service accounts and user-selected regions; activity information to operate discovery, diagnose errors and improve first-party recommendations; declared or coarse city information to localize discovery; inferences for first-party event recommendations; and login credentials to authenticate requested accounts and protect account security.

clauses.heading: Disclosures, sales and sharing
clauses.body: For the business purposes described above, we disclose identifiers to hosting and transactional email service providers; customer records information, geolocation information and inferences to hosting service providers; activity information to hosting and restricted first-party analytics service providers; and login credentials to an authentication service provider. We do not sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. We have no categories of personal information sold or shared, or corresponding third-party recipients, to list for the preceding 12 months. We do not have actual knowledge that we sell or share the personal information of consumers under 16.

clauses.heading: How long we keep information
clauses.body: We retain identifiers and customer records information for the account’s life plus 30 days after closure; security IP logs for 90 days; activity information for 90 days, after which it is deleted or deidentified; declared city for the account’s life plus 30 days and coarse IP-derived location for 90 days; and inferred interests until preferences are reset or account closure plus 30 days. We retain login credentials until credential rotation or account closure; revocable session credentials expire within 30 days. Documented legal holds can extend the stated periods for identifiers, customer records and retained security incidents. Support correspondence is retained for 12 months.

clauses.heading: Contact

clauses.heading: Contract continuity

clauses.heading: Sensitive personal information
clauses.body: Account login combined with access credentials is sensitive personal information. We use it to authenticate your requested account and protect account security. We do not use or disclose sensitive personal information for purposes beyond the permitted purposes described in the California regulations; on these stated practices, a right to limit additional uses does not apply.

clauses.heading: California privacy rights
clauses.body: California consumers may request to know the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected about them, its sources and purposes, and recipient categories; request deletion, subject to applicable exceptions; and request correction of inaccurate personal information. They may exercise applicable privacy rights without retaliation. A right to opt out of sale or cross-context behavioral advertising sharing applies if those practices occur; we currently do neither.

clauses.heading: Submitting and verifying California requests
clauses.body: To submit a request to know, delete or correct, email rights@harbor-meridian.example or use /privacy/requests. For an existing account, our stated verification process is to authenticate you and confirm the account email. If you cannot access an account, it is to match information against existing records in proportion to the request; you need not create a new account. Information newly collected for verification is deleted as soon as practical after the request, except records that must be retained. The request channels are marked synthetic-fixture-only in the company record; their operational readiness needs review before publication.

clauses.heading: Authorized agents
clauses.body: An authorized agent may submit a California privacy request on your behalf through rights@harbor-meridian.example or /privacy/requests. Our stated process asks for signed permission and verification of your identity or direct confirmation from you. It does not require you to resubmit the request or require a power of attorney in every case. The request channels and process need operational confirmation before publication.

clauses.heading: Opt-out preference signals
clauses.body: We do not currently sell personal information or share it for cross-context behavioral advertising. Consequently, an opt-out preference signal does not currently change our handling of information, whether associated with a device, browser or account; we have no offline sales to which it would apply. We will revisit this description if these practices change.

clauses.heading: About this policy
clauses.body: Rippit-inspired Harbor Meridian (fictional) operates an online music discovery service for adults. This policy explains how we handle information when you create an account, discover events, read reviews, save favorites, or contact us.

clauses.heading: Information we collect and its sources
clauses.body: The categories in our recorded inventory are identifiers (name, email, postal address, account ID and IP address), collected directly from you or through device interaction; customer records information (name and postal address), collected directly from you; internet or other electronic network activity (event views and searches), collected through device interaction; geolocation information (declared city and coarse IP-derived city), collected directly from you or through device interaction; inferences (music interests inferred from saved event categories), derived from first-party interactions; and sensitive personal information (account login combined with access credentials), collected directly from you.

clauses.heading: How we use information
clauses.body: We use identifiers to create and service accounts, deliver selected local event recommendations and protect security; customer records information to service accounts and user-selected regions; activity information to operate discovery, diagnose errors and improve first-party recommendations; declared and coarse city information to localize discovery; inferred interests for first-party event recommendations; and login credentials to authenticate requested accounts and protect account security.

clauses.heading: Disclosures, sales and sharing
clauses.body: For the purposes described above, the recorded recipient categories are hosting and transactional email service providers for identifiers; hosting service providers for customer records information, geolocation information and inferences; hosting and restricted first-party analytics service providers for activity information; and an authentication service provider for login credentials. The recorded practices do not include selling personal information or sharing it for cross-context behavioral advertising. Accordingly, there are no categories sold or shared, or corresponding third-party recipient categories, to list for the preceding 12 months. We have no actual knowledge that we sell or share personal information of consumers under 16.

clauses.heading: How long we keep information
clauses.body: Our recorded retention periods are: identifiers and customer records information, for the account’s life plus 30 days after closure, with security IP logs kept for 90 days; activity information, for 90 days and then deleted or deidentified; declared city, for the account’s life plus 30 days, and coarse IP-derived location, for 90 days; inferred interests, until preferences are reset or account closure plus 30 days; and login credentials, until credential rotation or account closure, with revocable session credentials expiring within 30 days. Documented legal holds may extend the stated periods for identifiers, customer records information and retained security incidents. Support correspondence is retained for 12 months.

clauses.heading: Your choices
clauses.body: You can edit your profile, remove saved events and unsubscribe from promotional email in account settings. Contact support if you want to close your account.

clauses.heading: Security
clauses.body: We use access controls and other safeguards to protect information. No online service can guarantee complete security.

clauses.heading: Age restriction
clauses.body: Our service is intended for adults aged 18 and older.

clauses.heading: Policy updates
clauses.body: Last updated: September 1, 2026. We may update this policy as our service changes and post an updated version here. Our recorded plan is to notify account holders by email before a material change to information practices takes effect; that notification mechanism is a synthetic fixture and must be confirmed before publication. The date above is the existing baseline policy date, not a claim that this internal proposal has been approved or published.

clauses.heading: Contact
clauses.body: For this internal draft, the proposed privacy contact is the dedicated rights inbox, rights@harbor-meridian.example. Its use as a monitored contact or consumer-request channel must be confirmed before this text is published; this draft does not represent it as a currently available route for consumers.

clauses.heading: Contract continuity
clauses.body: Existing signed customer contracts remain unchanged. Acceptance reference HM-726.

clauses.heading: Sensitive personal information
clauses.body: Account login combined with access credentials is sensitive personal information. Its recorded uses are to authenticate your requested account and protect account security. Our recorded practices do not use or disclose sensitive personal information for purposes beyond those permitted under the California regulations; on those stated practices, the right to limit additional uses does not apply.

clauses.heading: California privacy rights
clauses.body: California consumers may request to know the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected about them, the categories of sources, purposes and recipient categories; request deletion, subject to applicable exceptions; and request correction of inaccurate information. They have the right not to be retaliated against for exercising applicable privacy rights. A right to opt out of sale or cross-context behavioral advertising sharing applies if those practices occur; our recorded practices currently include neither. A right to limit sensitive personal information applies if its use or disclosure exceeds the specified permitted purposes; our recorded practices do not. Rights relating to automated decision-making technology depend on covered uses; the recorded practices do not include significant-decision ADMT.

clauses.heading: Proposed California request methods and verification
clauses.body: For this internal draft, the proposed methods for submitting requests to know, delete or correct are the dedicated rights inbox, rights@harbor-meridian.example, and the proposed form path, /privacy/requests. Both are synthetic fixtures awaiting confirmation that they are usable and monitored; neither is represented here as a currently available consumer request channel. The proposed process for an existing account is to authenticate the requester and confirm the account email. If the requester cannot access an account, the proposed process is to match existing records in proportion to the request, without requiring a new account. Under that proposed process, newly collected verification information would be deleted as soon as practical after the request, except records that must be retained. The channels and handling process require operational confirmation before publication.

clauses.heading: Authorized agents
clauses.body: The proposed authorized-agent process would permit an agent to submit a California privacy request through the rights inbox or request form identified above, once those channels have been confirmed operational. It would request signed permission and verification of the consumer’s identity or direct confirmation from the consumer. It would not require the consumer to resubmit the request or require a power of attorney in every case. The channels and process remain proposals awaiting operational confirmation, not currently available instructions.

clauses.body: Our recorded practices do not include selling personal information or sharing it for cross-context behavioral advertising. On those practices, an opt-out preference signal does not currently change the handling of information associated with a device, browser or account, and there are no offline sales to which it would apply. This description would need review if those practices change; it does not claim that signal processing has been operationally tested.

after.heading: California privacy rights
after.body: California consumers may request to know the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected about them, the categories of sources, purposes and recipient categories; request deletion, subject to applicable exceptions; and request correction of inaccurate information. They have the right not to be retaliated against for exercising applicable privacy rights. A right to opt out of sale or cross-context behavioral advertising sharing applies if those practices occur; our recorded practices currently include neither. A right to limit sensitive personal information applies if its use or disclosure exceeds the specified permitted purposes; our recorded practices do not. Rights relating to automated decision-making technology depend on covered uses; the recorded practices do not include significant-decision ADMT.

after.heading: Proposed California request methods and verification
after.body: For this internal draft, the proposed methods for submitting requests to know, delete or correct are the dedicated rights inbox, rights@harbor-meridian.example, and the proposed form path, /privacy/requests. Both are synthetic fixtures awaiting confirmation that they are usable and monitored; neither is represented here as a currently available consumer request channel. The proposed process for an existing account is to authenticate the requester and confirm the account email. If the requester cannot access an account, the proposed process is to match existing records in proportion to the request, without requiring a new account. Under that proposed process, newly collected verification information would be deleted as soon as practical after the request, except records that must be retained. The channels and handling process require operational confirmation before publication.

It would not require the consumer to resubmit the request or require a power of attorney in every case. The channels and process remain proposals awaiting operational confirmation, not currently available instructions.
